{"subject": "Reviewing your accounts and held-away assets", "body": "Dear Rowan Household,

Thank you for your continued relationship with us since 2016. I am writing to suggest a review of your accounts and your held-away assets at Halden Private Client.

Your household currently holds USD 6,180,000 across 2 accounts, including USD 367,426 in cash and USD 1,840,000 in held-away assets. Your largest holding is the Total market ETF (VTI) at 42.1% of AUM.

Our last meeting was Oct 24, 2025, and your next review is due Oct 24, 2026. I would welcome a conversation to confirm your current priorities and discuss whether consolidating held-away assets fits your plans.

Please let me know a time that works for you.

Sincerely,
Dana Whitfield", "claims": [{"text": "since 2016", "source_field": "client_since_year"}, {"text": "USD 6,180,000", "source_field": "aum"}, {"text": "2 accounts", "source_field": "account_count"}, {"text": "USD 1,840,000", "source_field": "held_away_usd"}, {"text": "Oct 24, 2026", "source_field": "next_review_date"}]}
